description: read_varint indexes the line table without checking its length.

provenance.construction: reverse of 9ab9703c9b: the new side of the diff is the code before the change

expected.rationale: The deleted checks returned None once the index ran past the table. Without them, a line table that ends in the middle of a value, as seen with Python 3.12, makes the profiler panic instead of falling back to a default line number. A crash while profiling is HIGH, and the linked issue reports exactly such a panic. This level is a judgement, not an advisory rating.

issues.description: read_varint reads table[*index] with no bounds check, so a truncated line table panics.
